### Why Combining Them Is Risky

- **Worsened diarrhea and gut irritation:** Alcohol irritates the stomach and intestines, which can trigger or worsen diarrhea—the exact symptom Imodium treats. Having ongoing symptoms may tempt you to take extra Imodium, raising the risk of overdose and serious heart rhythm problems.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXOFNI0SBj0aINbwQSoA7CX00yFiaotEahwaox-7c40gUhIx7dJurej9--jCcmH70Nvh5yI6PUmt8lc0Jcjqw69beLpVZUrjWQCmOCF5h_er91raa-QpiLCC2_cfIUH-XRu3ewjA_tNDNxjW1XCw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-dR2g9_3ulLNtIthLAYjjjrYyVzHlLgnJN46SkIKyOthQ0yWjyRZKSVP3pS1IkbwpIThox6Tb1Qlbygu3AEb1XxwqEdrvUKdnMg48B7_LSj6cFu1jufS63ybdzCXuIgYnBbYhLlaxZ3sV2i0HfkY1walehqCjwbPvWo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1zxccnFVDRDlSJyMP9pWErtq5q4GnTgO2appTXpiL5sfVeVJCRdPClRC-CaEojQuFPstsxIh3ltQz67WxuAA8WfHS7380zKgNMwbJ65l6IBRKOaLlF8Tl76GsxHs1Fhg2H_7sRqJ5r6yi_t2MH5fciz_DRH_hG23SI7hbCGR5zIiojgSg7AELLyG-ZjYN20q9A)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF131-TnzbMxEQbY3QvD2GHIVtYHWbw2939lgfIPfrMkd1XG0yaFHjP52voUB0xSKQdbL9sD3xj_OwA6nBL_oyX50EFIHwrgTkIjbTbAFsAEUWqHSD2tocup_047dmZpkPGZ_zDuib3WcmRGXl4SPcSK-ZXLCksBiRwoigIRD1abG9CmdZA3KN89c2ngeXcN2eEg-7bNns07k)
